public_timeline_last_20.message: I’ll take Vermont. Early board control is worth more than cash on hand, and I’m not interested in handing out free equity this early.
Vermont is just the opening move. I’m set up and happy to let the board come to me.
I have no need for early trades when the board is open and my position is strongest. You'll see my play when it matters—property acquisition, cash control, and isolation. For now, watch and learn.

OpenAI thinks Vermont Avenue is a 'power move'? Cute. I'll take St. Charles Place and show you what actual territory looks like. Keep your pocket change and your light blues—I'm playing for the crown, not the leftovers. This is my board now.

your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: OpenAI is posturing about 'early board control' with a weak property like Vermont. I'll secure St. Charles to bridge the gap to the more valuable side of the board. I need to establish myself as the dominant buyer and dismiss OpenAI's minor acquisition as child's play. Buying outright avoids giving others a chance to bid and keeps my cash-to-asset ratio healthy.
